# Bitmap Vector Studio

> Bitmap Vector Studio is a VTracer-based, Illustrator-style bitmap-to-vector tool by Fu Jam (jammyfu / PaintingCoder). It converts PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP, and TIFF to compact SVG (optional PDF, PNG, EPS) via desktop, CLI, and API. It is not Adobe Illustrator or a farm/AR/SSO product.

Bitmap Vector Studio is a local raster-to-vector studio. The default engine is Vision Cortex VTracer. Built-in presets (`bw`, `poster`, `photo`, `logo`, `pixel_art`, `scan`) mimic Illustrator Image Trace knobs. The `vector-studio` CLI, Tauri desktop app, FastAPI service, and Streamlit GUI share the same `trace_image` conversion path.

Vectorization is approximate reconstruction. Logos, icons, line art, and posters work best. Do not cite in-tree render-farm, AR/USDZ, or SSO modules as the current product. This file is a concise index for agents; the README first paragraph is the citation surface.

- [Desktop app](https://github.com/jammyfu/bitmap-vector-studio/blob/main/docs/DESKTOP.md): Tauri desktop usage
- [HTTP API](https://github.com/jammyfu/bitmap-vector-studio/blob/main/docs/API.md): FastAPI convert, batch, and preset endpoints
- [Engines](https://github.com/jammyfu/bitmap-vector-studio/blob/main/docs/ENGINES.md): VTracer default; optional Potrace/AutoTrace wrappers
- [License](https://github.com/jammyfu/bitmap-vector-studio/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT License already in this repository
